verdict.rationale: Marqeta explicitly documents an 'Agentic AI MCP Server' by name for AI agents, including instant virtual card issuance and spend controls (velocity limits, spending caps, merchant restrictions) — directly matching the story's merchant-lock and amount-cap requirements, backed by broader Core API docs on velocity/authorization controls and card creation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of card expiry as a settable control and independent/hands-on corroboration of an agent actually using a scoped card end-to-end.
